project.name: Vidocq :: MicroProfile Extensions :: Config (Ravel) :: Codegen Bundle
project.description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-ravel-config-extension. Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the application depends on the Config extension; Maven resolves the transitive APT dependencies below automatically.
Runs Ravel's Build Compatible Extension (ConfigCdiExtension) inside the Vauban processor, so the @ConfigProperty / @ConfigProperties beans it synthesises exist when the processor validates the deployment. Without it, every @Inject @ConfigProperty point fails the compilation as an unsatisfied dependency (ravel#21). Configuration values are still checked when the container starts, where the deployment's configuration is known.
